At a touch of a button, you’re able to control and set the time, temperature, lights, chromotherapy, and other settings for your sauna.

At InfraredSaunaParts, you can easily purchase touch pads, circuit boards, control panels, and many many more infrared sauna parts that you need by browsing through our catalogue. We’re constantly updating our catalogue to ensure our customers are able to find exactly what they need and even if you still can’t find what you’re looking for, give us a call right away to tell us what you need and we’ll work to find them for you.
